packages.name: nrfx
packages.comment: The complete upstream is pinned as an immutable git submodule. The standalone core and drivers consume the same upstream checkout; the duplicate MDK/startup snapshot has been removed. Selected-file identities and hashes remain locked by sources.lock.

packages.name: CMSIS
packages.comment: CMSIS Core headers are imported unmodified under external/cmsis; exact file hashes are in the vendor import manifest referenced by sources.lock.

packages.name: CherryUSB
packages.comment: The complete upstream is pinned as an immutable git submodule. NrfKit owns the LM20 DWC2 glue and target-local configuration; exact audited upstream-file hashes are in sources.lock.

packages.name: Trusted Firmware-M startup comparison
packages.comment: Audit evidence only; not imported in M0.

packages.name: Nordic sdk-nrfxlib SoftDevice Controller and MPSL
packages.comment: First-class immutable upstream submodule. The initial selection is the secure nrf54lm hard-float MPSL plus Multirole, Peripheral-only, and Central-only SDC archives from binary manifest revision c8da3098f9f034a44b6ebad30819cc0cea51da47.

packages.name: Nordic S115 SoftDevice
packages.comment: Optional external binary/API package; not imported in M0 and restricted to Nordic integrated circuits.

relationships.comment: Version-locked upstream submodule plus an imported LM20A MDK/startup subset
Version-locked upstream submodule used by the optional LM20 USBHS device integration
Version-locked first-class MPSL and SoftDevice Controller submodule for the current wireless direction
